areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Primary-care health units expansion fits; indicators on visits and prenatal care; about 10% of resources; impact judged high but level kept low by resource share.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: High coherence among objectives, components, indicators and funding; integrated urban, mobility, sanitation and social facilities; about 80% of resources; high impact.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Health-and-leisure complexes with outdoor exercise spaces give some adherence; resource allocation residual and not structuring, though impact seen as significant.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Urban requalification with green infrastructure, drainage and nature-based solutions; sanitation and water-quality indicators; about 30% of resources; elevated environmental impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Civil-defense risk-management structure and clear indicators; resource allocation residual, though solutions judged high-impact and efficient.

bonus.reason: Proponent claimed alignment with two federal priorities (climate emergency, health care), but resources are not entirely directed to them.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
